title: Early-warning health mesh for Private VPCs: Terraform modules, upgrade gating, and throughput metering
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: Private (VPC) deployments lack a lightweight, automated early-warning layer that can (1) detect emerging token-throughput saturation and request-level tail latency regressions, (2) gate upgrades/rollouts for private customers, and (3) be managed via Terraform as a first-class module. Goals: build a "heartbeat mesh" that runs as a minimal sidecar/agent in each private worker pool, surface a small set of derived SLO signals (latency p95/p99, 5m error rate, saturation index, token-throughput watermark), provide a Terraform module to provision mesh config and alerting, and wire upgrade gates to automatically pause/rollback upgrades when SLOs deteriorate. Scope: Terraformed modules + CI plan/validation, exporter/agent binary config, central aggregator (Datadog/Prometheus/Grafana), upgrade-gate integration with our private orchestrator. Out of scope for this ticket: full traffic shaping/circuit breaker implementation and per-tenant custom SLOs (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Terraform module (module.vpc_health_mesh) exists in infra/terraform/modules with inputs for sampling rate, watermark thresholds, and alert channels
Health-mesh agents deployed to staging private clusters expose metrics: vpc.request.latency.p95, vpc.request.latency.p99, vpc.error_rate.5m, vpc.saturation_index, vpc.token.throughput.per_shard
Central aggregator dashboard (Grafana) shows mesh-derived signals for all private clusters and supports time-range comparisons for canary windows
Automated upgrade-gate: Terraform-driven rollout job will pause and mark canary as failed if p99 increases by >30% or error_rate > 1% over the canary window
Integration tests that simulate a token-throughput spike (>= 3x baseline) validate that saturation_index triggers alert and the upgrade-gate responds within the configured rollback window
Security review sign-off recorded and module supports optional KMS/HSM integration for agent credentials
technical_notes: Metrics and calculations: saturation_index = min(1.0, (observed_tokens_per_second / provisioned_token_capacity)) sampled at 10s granularity

Agent: light-weight Go binary (health-mesh-agent) exposes /metrics for Prometheus and a compact heartbeat to the aggregator over TLS (mutual auth). Use existing KMS keys for agent identity when security_review_required=true
Terraform contract: inputs = {sampling_rate, watermark_low, watermark_high, canary_window_minutes, alert_channel_ids, kms_key_id (optional)}, outputs = {dashboard_url, alert_ids, module_id}

Alerting rules: stable baseline computed from 7-day rolling window; canary compares last canary_window_minutes vs baseline; thresholds default: p99_delta_percent=30, error_rate_threshold=0.01, saturation_watermark=0.75
Storage/aggregation: use existing prom-remote-write path into central metrics cluster. Tag metrics with private_cluster_id, az, and node_role
Rollout gating: integrate with private orchestrator operator via a webhook API; operator supports pause/rollback commands and emits events for audit logs
rollout_plan: 1) Module and agent baked in feature branch; merge tests validate terraform fmt/validate and module static checks
2) Deploy to staging private pools (canary pool size = 2 nodes) with sampling_rate=0.2 for initial sampling
3) Run synthetic workload harness for 2h to establish baseline; capture p95/p99 and token throughput
4) Enable upgrade-gate in staging with canary_window=15m; run an upgrade and validate automatic pause/rollback on injected failure (fault-inject error-rate > 2%)
5) Gradually increase sampling to 1.0 and expand to pre-prod pools; run longer soak (48h) and run capacity spike test (3x tokens/s) to validate saturation triggers
6) Post-mortem and fast-follow: improve threshold defaults, add playbook entries for on-call, and cross-link to console rollout UI
7) GA: land module in private-2025.03 release and document usage in internal Terraform module catalog
comments: 2025-02-10 Maya Patel: Created ticket after spike. Spike found that naive per-request sampling doubled tail latency under synthetic load due to exporter contention; moved to sampled aggregated counters + periodic heartbeat to reduce noise.

2025-02-12 Harpreet Singh: Agent prototype (Go) pushed to infra branch; TLS mutual-auth working with test certs. Found edge-case where short-lived workers never report an initial heartbeat; will add join-window grace period.
2025-02-13 PM review (Daniel Kwon): Prioritize upgrade-gate integration — product needs automatic refusal of upgrades when customers are impacted. Add audit events to the acceptance criteria.

2025-02-15 Security (Ayesha Noor): Security review request submitted. Notes: require optional KMS integration and rotation for agent credentials; do not hardcode keys into TF state. Marking security_review_required=true.

2025-02-17 QA (Lina Rodriguez): Integration test run: saturation-index alert fired and Grafana panel updated, but the orchestrator webhook ignored the first pause event due to 429 throttling from operator. Next action: add exponential backoff and idempotency keys to webhook client.
2025-02-19 Harpreet Singh: Fixed webhook client and added retry with jitter. Added playbook steps for on-call to temporarily increase sampling when investigating noisy environments.
2025-02-20 Maya Patel: Ready for design review with infra and product. Next sprint: finalize default thresholds and add canary run to deployment pipeline
